questions.question: The marked price of a painting was ₹6,400, but the shopkeeper offered a double discount in a successive manner of 25% and 12%. Ultimately for how much did he sell the item?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use successive discount formula

Net % = 100 − (25 + 12) + (25 × 12)/100

= 100 − 37 + 3 = 66%

Selling Price = 6400 × 66/100 = 4224

**∴ Answer = ₹4224**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price = ₹6400

Discounts = 25% and 12%

**Formula used:**

Selling Price = MP × (1 − d1/100) × (1 − d2/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ After 25% discount ⇒ Price = 6400 × 75/100 = 4800

⇒ After 12% discount ⇒ Price = 4800 × 88/100

⇒ = 4224

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4224.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

Net discount = a + b − (ab/100)

Multiplier Method

Use (1 − d/100) for each discount step.

Important Concept

Successive discounts are not directly added.

questions.question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 85, 73, 89, 29, 20, 52, 22, 25 and 55 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed mean be 50.

Calculate deviations from 50: +35, +23, +39, −21, −30, +2, −28, −25, +5

Sum of positive deviations = +104 | Sum of negative deviations = −104

Net deviation = +104 − 104 = 0

Arithmetic Mean = Assumed Mean + (Net Deviation ÷ Total items) = 50 + (0 ÷ 9) = 50

**∴ The correct answer is 50.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations: 85, 73, 89, 29, 20, 52, 22, 25, 55

Number of observations (n) = 9

**Formula Used:**

Arithmetic Mean = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations

 
 Data: 85, 73, 89, 29, 20, 52, 22, 25, 55
 
 

 

 
 
 Sum of 9 items = 450
 
 

 

 
 
 Mean = 450 ÷ 9 = 50

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of observations = 85 + 73 + 89 + 29 + 20 + 52 + 22 + 25 + 55

⇒ Sum of observations = 450

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 450 ÷ 9

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 50

**∴ The correct answer is 50.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean

It is the ratio of the sum of all values to the total number of values in a dataset. Formula: Mean = Sum of observations ÷ Number of observations.

Assumed Mean Method

A highly effective technique for calculating averages without dealing with large sums. Average = Assumed Mean + (Net deviation ÷ Count).

Median

The middlemost value of a sorted dataset. If the total terms (n) are odd, Median = (n + 1) ÷ 2th term. For even, it is the average of the two middle terms.

Mode

The value that appears most frequently in a dataset. A dataset may contain one mode, multiple modes, or no mode at all.

questions.question: {Simplify } ( (1)/(1 - sin A) + (1)/(1 + sin A) ) times cos² A
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: (1/(1 − sinA) + 1/(1 + sinA)) = 2/(1 − sin²A)

And 1 − sin²A = cos²A

So expression = (2 / cos²A) × cos²A

= 2

**∴ Answer = 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(1/(1 − sinA) + 1/(1 + sinA)) × cos²A

**Concept Used:**

Algebraic simplification and trigonometric identity

**Calculation:**

⇒ Take LCM of (1 − sinA) and (1 + sinA)

⇒ = [(1 + sinA) + (1 − sinA)] / (1 − sin²A)

⇒ = 2 / (1 − sin²A)

⇒ Using identity: 1 − sin²A = cos²A

⇒ Expression = (2 / cos²A) × cos²A

⇒ = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Identity

sin²A + cos²A = 1 ⇒ 1 − sin²A = cos²A

Algebraic Identity

(1 − a)(1 + a) = 1 − a²

LCM Method

Combine fractions using LCM to simplify complex expressions.

questions.question: The age of Ajay is 16 years more than that of Vijay. The sum of their ages 6 years ago was 56 years. Find Vijay's present age.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Vijay = x, Ajay = x + 16

6 years ago: (x − 6) + (x + 16 − 6) = 56

⇒ 2x + 4 = 56 ⇒ 2x = 52 ⇒ x = 26

Vijay’s present age = 26 years

**∴ Answer = 26 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ajay is 16 years older than Vijay

Sum of their ages 6 years ago = 56

**Formula used:**

Form linear equation using age relations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Vijay’s present age = x

⇒ Ajay’s present age = x + 16

⇒ 6 years ago: Vijay = x − 6, Ajay = x + 10

⇒ (x − 6) + (x + 10) = 56

⇒ 2x + 4 = 56

⇒ 2x = 52

⇒ x = 26

**∴ The correct answer is 26 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Difference Concept

Difference between ages remains constant over time.

Linear Equation Method

Translate statements into equations and solve step by step.

Past Age Adjustment

Subtract years from present age to get past age values.

questions.question: Two banks, A and B, offered loans at 3.5% and 7% per annum, respectively. Gopal borrowed an amount of ₹5,00,000 from each bank. Find the positive difference (in ₹) between the amounts of simple interest paid to the two banks by Gopal after 3 years.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in rates = 7% − 3.5% = 3.5%

Use SI difference directly: SI = P × R × T / 100

= 500000 × 3.5 × 3 ÷ 100

= 52500

**∴ Answer = ₹52500**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal = ₹500000 (each bank)

Rates = 3.5% and 7%

Time = 3 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI from Bank A = (500000 × 3.5 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ = 52500

⇒ SI from Bank B = (500000 × 7 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ = 105000

⇒ Difference = 105000 − 52500 = 52500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹52500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Shortcut for Difference

Difference in SI = P × (R₁ − R₂) × T ÷ 100

Direct Proportionality

SI is directly proportional to Principal, Rate, and Time.

questions.question: If x = sqrt{30 + sqrt{30 + sqrt{30 + dots infty}}} and y = sqrt{30 - sqrt{30 - sqrt{30 - dots infty}}}, then what will the remainder be when the product of x and y is divided by 7
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let x = √(30 + x) and y = √(30 − y)

Square both ⇒ x² = 30 + x and y² = 30 − y

⇒ x² − x − 30 = 0 ⇒ x = 6, y² + y − 30 = 0 ⇒ y = 5

Product = 6 × 5 = 30

Remainder when 30 ÷ 7 = 2

**∴ Answer = 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x = √(30 + √(30 + √(30 + ...)))

y = √(30 − √(30 − √(30 − ...)))

**Concept Used:**

Infinite nested radicals assume same value inside

**Calculation:**

⇒ x = √(30 + x)

⇒ x² = 30 + x

⇒ x² − x − 30 = 0

⇒ (x − 6)(x + 5) = 0 ⇒ x = 6

⇒ y = √(30 − y)

⇒ y² = 30 − y

⇒ y² + y − 30 = 0

⇒ (y + 6)(y − 5) = 0 ⇒ y = 5

⇒ x × y = 6 × 5 = 30

⇒ 30 ÷ 7 ⇒ Remainder = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Infinite Surds

Assume x = √(a + x) or √(a − x) for repeating structure.

Quadratic Equation

Solve equations like x² − x − 30 = 0 by factorization.

Remainder Concept

Remainder = Dividend mod Divisor

questions.question: What is the fractional value of 3. 627272727….?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Number = 3.6(27)

Decimal part = 0.6 + 0.0272727…

= 6/10 + 27/990

= 3/5 + 3/110 = 66/110 + 3/110 = 69/110

Total = 3 + 69/110 = (330 + 69)/110 = 399/110

**∴ Answer = 399/110**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x = 3.6272727… (27 repeating)

**Formula used:**

Multiply and subtract method

**Calculation:**

⇒ x = 3.6272727…

⇒ 10x = 36.272727…

⇒ 1000x = 3627.272727…

⇒ Subtract: 1000x − 10x

⇒ 990x = 3591

⇒ x = 3591/990

⇒ Divide by 9 ⇒ x = 399/110

**∴ The correct answer is 399/110.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Recurring Decimal Rule

Use powers of 10 to align repeating digits and subtract.

Shortcut Method

For mixed recurring decimals: (Full number − non-repeating part) ÷ (99…0 form)

Denominator Rule

Use 9s for repeating digits and 0s for non-repeating digits.

questions.question: The mode and median of a data are 27.5 and 23, respectively. What is the mean of the data? (Use empirical formula.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the empirical relationship between Mean, Median, and Mode:

Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean

⇒ 27.5 = 3 × 23 − 2 × Mean

⇒ 2 × Mean = 69 − 27.5 = 41.5

⇒ Mean = 41.5 ÷ 2 = 20.75

**∴ The correct answer is 20.75.**

questions.question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 3, 4 and 12 days, respectively. How long (in days) will they take to do twice the same work, working together?

A = 12 ÷ 3 = 4, B = 12 ÷ 4 = 3, C = 12 ÷ 12 = 1

questions.question: The price of fuel decreases by 55%, 40% and 15% in three successive months, but increases by 60% in the fourth month. What is the percentage increase/decrease in the price of fuel in the fourth month as compared to its original price?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use multiplier method

After changes ⇒ 100 × 0.45 × 0.60 × 0.85 × 1.60

= 36.72

Change = 36.72 − 100 = −63.28%

**∴ Answer = 63.28% decrease**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Successive changes: −55%, −40%, −15%, +60%

**Formula used:**

Final Value = Initial × (1 ± change/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Assume initial price = 100

⇒ After 1st month = 100 × 45/100 = 45

⇒ After 2nd month = 45 × 60/100 = 27

⇒ After 3rd month = 27 × 85/100 = 22.95

⇒ After 4th month = 22.95 × 160/100 = 36.72

⇒ Net change = 36.72 − 100 = −63.28

**∴ The correct answer is 63.28% decrease.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Multiplier Method

Use (1 − d/100) for decrease and (1 + d/100) for increase.

Successive Percentage

Changes are applied step-by-step, not added directly.

Net Change Formula

Final % change = (Final − Initial) ÷ Initial × 100

questions.question: By selling a bicycle for ₹1,425, a shopkeeper gains 14%. If the profit is reduced to 8%, then the selling price will be:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

SP₁ : SP₂ = (100 + 14) : (100 + 8)

= 114 : 108

New SP = 1425 × (108 ÷ 114)

= 1425 × (18 ÷ 19) = 1350

**∴ Answer = ₹1350**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price = ₹1425 with 14% profit

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (1 + Profit/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 1425 = CP × 114/100

⇒ CP = 1425 × 100 ÷ 114

⇒ CP = 1250

⇒ New SP at 8% profit:

⇒ SP = 1250 × 108/100

⇒ SP = 1350

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1350.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit Formula

SP = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100

Ratio Method

SP ∝ (100 + Profit%) when CP is constant.

Quick Conversion

Use ratio to avoid finding CP directly.

questions.question: Two trains, A and B, of lengths 402 m and 286 m are running at speeds of 6 m/s and 37 m/s, respectively, towards each other on parallel tracks. In how much time will they cross each other?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Opposite direction ⇒ add speeds

Total distance = 402 + 286 = 688 m

Relative speed = 6 + 37 = 43 m/s

Time = 688 ÷ 43 = 16 s

**∴ Answer = 16 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of Train A = 402 m

Length of Train B = 286 m

Speeds = 6 m/s and 37 m/s

**Formula used:**

Time = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total distance to be covered = 402 + 286 = 688 m

⇒ Relative speed (opposite direction) = 6 + 37 = 43 m/s

⇒ Time = 688 ÷ 43

⇒ Time = 16 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 16 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Opposite direction ⇒ speeds add, Same direction ⇒ speeds subtract.

Train Crossing Concept

Total distance = sum of lengths when two trains cross each other.

Basic Formula

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

questions.question: There are some rabbits and parrots in a farmhouse. The total number of animal heads is 180 and the total number of legs is 520. Find the number of rabbits in the farmhouse.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume all are parrots ⇒ legs = 180 × 2 = 360

Extra legs = 520 − 360 = 160

Each rabbit adds 2 extra legs

Rabbits = 160 ÷ 2 = 80

**∴ Answer = 80 rabbits**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total heads = 180

Total legs = 520

**Formula used:**

Let rabbits = x, parrots = y

x + y = 180 and 4x + 2y = 520

**Calculation:**

⇒ x + y = 180 ⇒ y = 180 − x

⇒ Substitute in second equation:

⇒ 4x + 2(180 − x) = 520

⇒ 4x + 360 − 2x = 520

⇒ 2x = 160

⇒ x = 80

**∴ The correct answer is 80 rabbits.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Assumption Method

Assume all animals are of one type, then adjust using extra legs.

Linear Equations

Form equations based on heads and legs to solve.

Concept

Rabbit = 4 legs, Parrot = 2 legs.

questions.question: Rohit goes to a shop to purchase a truck priced at ₹6,900. He is offered 4 discount options by the shopkeeper. Which of these options should he opt for to gain maximum advantage of the discount offered?

Successive Discount Formula

Net discount = a + b − (ab/100)

Maximum discount ⇒ Minimum selling price.

questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill an empty cistern in 46 minutes and 32 minutes, respectively. Both Pipe A and Pipe B are opened together. After how much time should Pipe B be turned off so that the empty cistern is completely filled in a total of 23 minutes?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let total work = LCM(46, 32) = 736 units

A = 736 ÷ 46 = 16 units/min, B = 736 ÷ 32 = 23 units/min

Let B runs for x min ⇒ A runs full 23 min

Total work: 16×23 + 23×x = 736

⇒ 368 + 23x = 736 ⇒ 23x = 368 ⇒ x = 16

**∴ Answer = 16 minutes**

questions.question: A room is one and a half times as long as it is wide. The cost of carpeting the floor at ₹18 per square metre is ₹3,888, and the cost of whitewashing the four walls at ₹9 per square metre is ₹4,320. Find the volume of the room in cubic metres.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Floor area = 3888 ÷ 18 = 216 m²

Let width = w ⇒ length = 3w/2

Area ⇒ (3w/2) × w = 216 ⇒ w² = 144 ⇒ w = 12, l = 18

Walls area = 4320 ÷ 9 = 480 ⇒ 2h(l + w) = 480

⇒ 2h(30) = 480 ⇒ h = 8

Volume = l × w × h = 18 × 12 × 8 = 1728

**∴ Answer = 1728 m³**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length = 1.5 × Width

Cost of carpeting = ₹3888 at ₹18/m²

Cost of whitewashing walls = ₹4320 at ₹9/m²

**Formula used:**

Area of floor = l × w

Area of four walls = 2h(l + w)

Volume = l × w × h

**Calculation:**

⇒ Floor area = 3888 ÷ 18 = 216 m²

⇒ Let width = w, then length = 3w/2

⇒ (3w/2) × w = 216

⇒ 3w²/2 = 216 ⇒ w² = 144 ⇒ w = 12 m

⇒ Length = 18 m

questions.question: A person who spends 60% of his monthly income is able to save ₹8,242 per month. His monthly expenses (in ₹) are:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the expenses percentage into a fraction: 60% = 3 ÷ 5

Let Total Income = 5 units, which means Expenses = 3 units.

Savings = Income − Expenses = 5 − 3 = 2 units.

Given Savings = 2 units = ₹8,242

Expenses (3 units) = (8242 ÷ 2) × 3 = 4121 × 3 = ₹12,363.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12,363.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage of monthly income spent = 60%

Monthly Savings = ₹8,242

**Formula Used:**

Total Income = 100% = Expenses % + Savings %

Savings % = 100% − Expenses %

 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Total Income (100%)
 
 
 
 
 Expenses (60%)
 Value = ?
 
 Savings (40%)
 ₹8,242

**Calculations:**

⇒ Savings % = 100% − 60% = 40%

⇒ According to the question, 40% of the income = ₹8,242

⇒ 1% of the income = 8242 ÷ 40 = ₹206.05

⇒ Monthly Expenses (60%) = 60 × 206.05

⇒ Monthly Expenses = ₹12,363

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income, Expenditure, and Savings

The foundational rule of personal finance is Income = Expenditure + Savings. Knowing any two values or their respective percentages allows you to seamlessly calculate the third.

Fraction Equivalents of Percentages

Using fractions instead of percentages can drastically speed up your calculations. For example: 20% = 1/5, 25% = 1/4, 40% = 2/5, 60% = 3/5, and 80% = 4/5.

Base Change in Percentages

If A is R% more than B, then B is [R ÷ (100 + R)] × 100% less than A. This formula is highly useful when comparing the incomes or expenses between two distinct individuals.

questions.question: {Simplify the expression: } (7a + 4b)(7a - 4b)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct difference of squares identity: (x + y)(x − y) = x² − y²

Substitute x = 7a and y = 4b into the identity.

⇒ (7a)² − (4b)²

⇒ 49a² − 16b²

**∴ The correct answer is 49a² − 16b².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: (7a + 4b)(7a − 4b)

**Method Used:**

We can solve this by directly multiplying the two binomials by distributing each term (FOIL method).

**Calculations:**

⇒ (7a × 7a) + (7a × −4b) + (4b × 7a) + (4b × −4b)

⇒ 49a² − 28ab + 28ab − 16b²

⇒ The middle terms cancel out since −28ab + 28ab = 0.

⇒ 49a² − 16b²

**∴ The correct answer is 49a² − 16b².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square of a Binomial (Sum)

The square of the sum of two terms expands as: (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b².

Square of a Binomial (Difference)

The square of the difference of two terms expands as: (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b².

Sum and Difference of Cubes

Factorization formulas for cubes: a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) and a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²).

questions.question: A circle of radius 3 cm is drawn with its centre at one of the vertices of a regular hexagon of side 6 cm. What is the area (in cm²) of the hexagon which is NOT overlapping with the circle?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The interior angle of a regular hexagon is 120°.

The area overlapping between the circle and the hexagon is simply a 120° sector of the circle.

Area of Hexagon = (3√3 ÷ 2) × (Side)² = (3√3 ÷ 2) × 6² = 54√3 cm²

Area of Sector = (120° ÷ 360°) × π × r² = (1 ÷ 3) × π × 3² = 3π cm²

Required non-overlapping area = Area of Hexagon − Area of Sector = 54√3 − 3π

**∴ The correct answer is 54√3 − 3π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Side of the regular hexagon (a) = 6 cm

⇒ Radius of the circle (r) = 3 cm

⇒ The circle is centered at one of the vertices of the hexagon.

 
 
 
 120° Hexagon Area Circle Center 
• 
• 
• Side = 6 cm r = 3 cm 
• 

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Area of a regular hexagon = (3√3 ÷ 2) × a²

⇒ Area of a sector = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr²

**Calculations:**

⇒ The interior angle of a regular hexagon is 120°. Therefore, the portion of the circle that overlaps with the hexagon forms a sector of exactly 120°.

⇒ Overlapping Area = Area of the sector with radius 3 cm and angle 120°

⇒ Overlapping Area = (120° ÷ 360°) × π × (3)²

⇒ Overlapping Area = (1 ÷ 3) × 9π = 3π cm²

⇒ Total Area of the Hexagon = (3√3 ÷ 2) × (6)²

⇒ Total Area of the Hexagon = (3√3 ÷ 2) × 36 = 54√3 cm²

⇒ Area not overlapping = Total Area of the Hexagon − Overlapping Area

⇒ Area not overlapping = 54√3 − 3π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 54√3 − 3π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Interior Angle of Regular Polygons

The measure of each interior angle of an n-sided regular polygon is given by the formula [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n. For a regular hexagon (n = 6), the interior angle is precisely 120°.

Area of a Regular Hexagon

A regular hexagon can be divided evenly into 6 identical equilateral triangles meeting at the center. Thus, its total area formula is 6 × (√3 ÷ 4)a² = (3√3 ÷ 2)a², where a is the side length.

Area of a Circular Sector

A sector is a geometric portion of a circle enclosed by two radii and an connecting arc. Its area is calculated as (θ ÷ 360°) × πr², where θ is the central angle in degrees.

questions.question: A car covers 100 km in the first hour, 150 km in the second hour, and 50 km in the third hour. If it continues at a speed of 60 km/hr for the next 2 hours, what is the average speed for the entire journey?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance = 100 + 150 + 50 + (60 × 2) = 420 km

Total time = 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 = 5 hours

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

= 420 ÷ 5 = 84 km/hr

**∴ Answer = 84 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distances covered each hour: 100, 150, 50 km

Next 2 hours speed = 60 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Distance in 4th and 5th hour = 60 × 2 = 120 km

⇒ Total distance = 100 + 150 + 50 + 120 = 420 km

⇒ Total time = 5 hours

⇒ Average speed = 420 ÷ 5

⇒ = 84 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 84 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed Formula

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

Key Concept

Different speeds require total distance approach, not simple average.

Uniform Motion

Distance = Speed × Time

questions.question: {If a four-digit number } 34X1 { is divisible by } 7, { then } X² { is:}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use rule: (Last digit × 2) subtracted from remaining

Number = 34X1 ⇒ 340 + X1 form

Try values: 3431 ÷ 7 = 490 + 1 ⇒ not divisible

Try X = 3 ⇒ 3431, actually 3431 = 7 × 490 + 1 ❌

Try X = 5 ⇒ 3451 = 7 × 493 ✔

X = 5 ⇒ X² = 25

**∴ Answer = 25**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 34X1 is divisible by 7

**Concept Used:**

Divisibility rule of 7 or direct division

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let number = 3401 + 10X

⇒ Check divisibility: 3401 ÷ 7 = 486 remainder 5

⇒ So (3401 + 10X) mod 7 = 0

⇒ 5 + (10X mod 7) = 0

⇒ 10 mod 7 = 3 ⇒ 5 + 3X ≡ 0 (mod 7)

⇒ 3X ≡ 2 (mod 7)

⇒ X = 5

⇒ X² = 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 7

Double the last digit and subtract from remaining number repeatedly.

Modular Arithmetic

Use remainders to simplify divisibility conditions.

Trial Method

Try possible digit values (0–9) if equation is simple.

Quick Insight

Convert number into algebraic form for faster solving.
